subject.title: Feishu auto-reply and `message` tool path bypass `message_sending` / `reply_payload_sending` / `message_sent` plugin hooks

question: Should maintainers split this issue so Feishu outbound hook parity lands first while normal-channel `inbound_claim` broadening is tracked separately?
rationale: The outbound hook bypass is a documented P1 parity bug, but expanding `inbound_claim` to ordinary channel traffic changes claim authority and plugin ordering semantics across channels.

options.title: Split outbound parity from inbound claim
options.body: Fix Feishu/shared configured-dispatcher `message_sending` coverage through the existing hook-bypass PR track and open or retain a separate `inbound_claim` API/security discussion.

options.title: Fold all outbound work into the canonical hook issue
options.body: Move the Feishu acceptance criteria under https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/92374 and leave this issue focused only on the separate inbound-claim question.

options.title: Solve every hook request together
options.body: Use one broader design PR for outbound parity and normal inbound claiming, accepting higher review cost and higher ordering/security risk.

recommendation.title: Split outbound parity from inbound claim
recommendation.body: Fix Feishu/shared configured-dispatcher `message_sending` coverage through the existing hook-bypass PR track and open or retain a separate `inbound_claim` API/security discussion.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved decision centers on `inbound_claim` and plugin conversation-binding semantics from the plugin-surface work they authored.
